**Evaluating building performance concepts**

The question emphasizes being “concerned with all aspects of building performance,” which suggests an integrated design or project delivery approach. However, it also mentions the need to coordinate different building systems to avoid rework, implying integration again. I think the answer revolves around whether the right approach is integrated, but I need to clarify my options better as I finalize.

**A. Integrated** — Integrated project delivery/design focuses on overall building performance and requires close coordination among building systems to prevent conflicts and rework.
